stem: Voltmarkt ran a 2-week promotion on Earbuds Pro X. Two sister earbuds in the same category were not on promotion. Earbuds Lite sold 47, 53, 52 and 48 units in the 4 weeks before the promotion, and 33 and 29 units in the 2 promotion weeks. Earbuds Sport sold 12, 10 and 14 units in three of the 4 weeks before; in the remaining week it sold nothing, so the sales data has no row for that week. During the promotion Sport sold 6 and 4 units. Voltmarkt's baseline is a product's average weekly units in the 4 weeks before the promotion, with a week without sales counted as 0. Cannibalised units are each sister product's drop below its baseline, per week, times the number of promotion weeks. How many units did the promotion cannibalise from the two sister products in total? Give a whole number.
